# Design to Ship

When a request concerns product definition, information architecture, UX flows, interface design, design systems, design-to-code work, or UI verification, read `skills/design-to-ship/SKILL.md` and its directly relevant references before acting.

Maintain an evidence ledger and trace consequential decisions to requirements. Never claim research, testing, accessibility compliance, or visual parity without evidence. For repository changes, follow `AGENTS.md` and run `python3 scripts/validate.py`.
